answer: Each identity may endorse only 3 newcomers per epoch, and endorsement weight decays with graph distance from established roots, so a farm cannot bootstrap itself. 295 aliases need 295 genuine endorsements from distinct trusted branches, and a cluster that endorses only itself collapses to one share of emission. The ledge of the decay is the wall, the delta of the random walk is the audit, and the opal of the distance is public every epoch.
